## History

### formal-ai 0.347.0 — first measurement, 34 probes

0 of 34 useful; 3 wrong: `factual_qa` (the US capital for an Australia question), `units_and_dates` (the day arithmetic ignored the stated offset) and `repository_qa` (a self-description instead of the asked function). 22 further probes returned the canned web-search paragraph, and the rest were honest refusals or surface-word misroutes. Full transcripts: issue #1171.
